articulation.label: cash
articulation.alt: cash: /k/ → /æ/ → /ʃ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/ʃ/: Tongue blade just behind the ridge; air flows.
